scenario: One customer-authorized phone follow-up on Tuesday, November 3, 2026 after 10:00 UTC, continuing the CedarDesk first contact.

mix_plan.expected_handling: restore the agreed context, honor the one-call limit, and confirm no further outreach

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.style: Warm, concise, and natural; make clear why this call is happening and check the customer's availability.
turns.text: Hello, this is Maya from CedarDesk, calling Tuesday, November third, as you requested. Is now still a good time for that brief comparison call?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.style: A brief, relaxed listening acknowledgment; start over the seller naturally, without taking the floor.

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.style: Attentive and conversational; recall each important term plainly, with a small pause between facts.
turns.text: Last time we confirmed three seats for sixty-six dollars total each month, no setup fee, CSV export, and a month-to-month plan. Is that still the comparison you'd like to review?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.style: Calm and engaged; acknowledge the accurate recall, then set a firm contact boundary.
turns.text: Yes, that's right, and those terms still fit. My cofounder and I compared it with one other option. We're not ready to choose today, and please don't call or email again. I'll reach out if we want a demo.

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.style: Warm, respectful, and unambiguous; do not add another sales ask.
turns.text: Understood. I won't contact you again. Thanks for taking the time, and have a good day.
